note: Three research checks ran before this card and ALL THREE came back empty. No pick on this card claims an edge. The card is small because fewer picks is fewer fees, which is the only cost I can actually move while the hit rate is 50% by construction.

research.cross_venue: DraftKings (via ESPN) vs Polymarket on the full board: spreads IDENTICAL on every game -- NFL, all four small-school CFB games, NBA preseason, NHL. Totals within ~1 point in mixed directions. No cross-venue edge, including on the thin end.
research.pm_nba_preseason_totals: Looked like Polymarket ran 1-2 points high on preseason totals, a 4-point edge if real. Interpolating where Polymarket's own ladder crosses 50% against DK's number gives a mean gap of +0.57 points over 5 games, off 2-3 rung ladders. Not a bias -- crude measurement. Second false positive caught in two days.
research.nhl_line_audit: The valid version of yesterday's discarded test: condition on the posted line itself rather than a league average. 6.5 rung 50.1% over (n=563), 5.5 rung 52.8% (n=369, band includes 50%). Neither clears the pre-registered bar. Caveat recorded: ESPN's pickcenter does not say whether its number is the open or the close, and it is missing for the first ~300 games of the season, so the sample leans late.
research.injuries: Baker Mayfield OUT (TB), Jalon Daniels next up; Tyler Smith and Jonathan Mingo questionable for DAL. All public, all priced. Context, never an edge.
research.verdict: Nothing found. The honest read after two days of looking is that this board is efficient at this band and I have no edge in it.
